title: Licensed Electrician HDB Full Rewiring & DB Box in Tampines
excerpt: Complete 4-room HDB flat electrical overhaul: EMA-compliant rewiring, 12-way Hager DB box, and RCCB safety testing.
content:
## Project Scope

- Complete HDB 4-room flat electrical rewiring adhering strictly to Singapore EMA and SS CP5 electrical standards.
- Upgraded obsolete fuse unit to a modern Hager 12-way Distribution Board (DB) with dedicated RCCB residual current circuit breakers.
- Installed 18 new double 13A switch socket outlets, concealed kitchen cooker point, and 14 dimmable architectural LED ceiling points.
- Completed insulation resistance testing and SP Services connection inspection with zero defects.

title: Emergency Power Trip & Short Circuit Repair in Jurong West
excerpt: Emergency troubleshooting for a total blackout caused by an underground concealed water heater short circuit. Restored power in 45 minutes.
content:
## Issue & Resolution

Homeowner experienced immediate main RCCB tripping whenever switching on the water heater circuit.
- Deployed diagnostic megohmmeter to trace concealed neutral-earth breakdown in the master bath conduit.
- Bypassed faulty segment with flame-retardant heat-resistant wiring.
- Full load stress test conducted and certified safe.
